title: Random school and bus question
content: In my recurring dream world that’s different every night like real life I visit my sister somewhere I think it’s NY but I always have to cross a schools field and there’s always snow on the ground. The town is very small, I know a lot of people there that I don’t know in real life, occasionally end up staying at this guys house who has a light blue house and a weather car port attached to it. (Like a garage without walls). My sister lives in the other part of town and the bus only takes me halfway and I get off and half to walk the rest of the way. It’s a big open road with snow and gravel and big fields and hills on either side. A beige or orange house lives adjacent to my sisters. I’ve met the people there a few times when they wait on their kids to get on their school bus. I don’t visit often, just wondering if this town sounds sort of familiar. Also does anyone else dream of a like inter dimensional bus that you can ride to travel places in your dreams? I use it to go places like Paris. But I live in another town and I just moved into a new apartment. I’m kind of tired of having another life in my dreams. I’m a mechanic for war trucks in the dream. My towns at war with someone idk we always get bombed and I have to help the soldiers. I’m ex military so maybe my dreams are just a reflection of stuff from there, but it’s too realistic. I have conversations with people real people but they aren’t real. Any similar experiences out there?
